caption: A disco ball turns under the stage lights, and dozens of small bright spots sweep across the walls.

sa.check: A disco ball turns under stage lights.
Small bright spots sweep across the walls.

pc.expect: The spots move when the ball turns and stop when it stops.
pc.fail: They are still while the ball turns; or sweep while the ball is still; or move out of time with it.

pc.expect: The spots do not move on their own.
pc.fail: They dance with the ball stopped; or flicker with steady lights.

pc.expect: The spots are many small bright patches, each roughly a facet's shape.
pc.fail: They merge into one flood; or they are sharp geometric shapes unlike facets; or they are a single spot.

pc.expect: The spots all sweep the same way round the room as the ball turns one way.
pc.fail: Some sweep the opposite way; or they jump; or they move crosswise.
A second ball appears; or the ball vanishes; or a spot becomes solid.

pc.expect: The room and the stage lights stay the same.
pc.fail: The room rearranges; or the lights change colour abruptly; or the ball changes.
